whatItIs: ValinityVDAOFactory: the SOLE deployer + source-of-truth for V-DAO tokens at VARO T4. Owns layer name/symbol DERIVATION (previewNames), the FCFS name/symbol UNIQUENESS registry (nameTaken/symbolTaken), and the PERMANENT on-token wiring (veo + mainDax) baked into every minted V-DAO — owned here, never passed by VARO, so a buggy VARO can't bake wrong exemptions. UUPS-upgradeable (patches FUTURE launches; deployed tokens are frozen). launch + reserveName are VARO_ROLE-only. ValinityVDAO: a fully-immutable ERC20+Permit+Burnable creator token (no admin/owner/upgrade, constructor-only). Total minted = 2x activeSupply: activeSupply -> factory -> VARO (the tradeable half VARO runs the launch split on); activeSupply -> the token itself, LOCKED as a 1-year linear creator vest (claimVested, creator-only). 0.7% transfer fee BURNED on every non-exempt transfer; exempt set (frozen) = {factory, address(this), varo, veo, vdax(main DAX)}.

discharges.VDAO-DAX-M3 (sender-side-FoT risk): DISCHARGED — the V-DAO fee is RECIPIENT-side: _update burns the fee OUT OF `value` (sender's balance drops by exactly `value`, recipient gets `value-fee`). So a non-exempt DEX sending a V-DAO out has its balance drop by exactly amountOut -> reserve stays in sync. The V-DAO is NOT a sender-side-FoT token.
discharges.DEX no-reentrancy assumption: DISCHARGED — plain ERC20+Burnable+Permit; _update only calls super._update (no external calls / no ERC777 hooks / no callbacks).
discharges.main-DAX exemption: CONFIRMED — mainDax is permanently feeExempt on every V-DAO (so the main DAX, which books requested amounts, never overcounts its V-DAO reserve). The VDAO-DAX is intentionally NOT exempt (balance-delta accounting makes the burn safe + deflationary).

audit.workflow: wg9tl6qlr (12 agents, 5 dimension finders -> adversarial verify -> synthesis). 49 raw -> 3 survived / 3 refuted / 43 Low-Info. Tally: 1 Critical, 1 High, 1 Medium, 4 Low/Info. ZERO permissionless-exploitable.
audit.verdict: CLOSED / no fund leak. The 3 KEY PROPERTIES the DEX audits assumed are CONFIRMED in code: (1) RECIPIENT-SIDE fee -- _update burns the 0.7% out of `value` (super._update(from,0,fee) then super._update(from,to,value-fee)), so the sender's balance drops by EXACTLY `value` and the recipient gets value-fee; a non-exempt DEX sending amountOut therefore has its balance drop by exactly amountOut -> reserve stays in sync (DISCHARGES VDAO-DAX-M3 -- the V-DAO is NOT sender-side-FoT). (2) HOOK-FREE -- plain ERC20+Burnable+Permit; _update only calls super._update (no external calls / ERC777 callbacks) (DISCHARGES the DEX no-reentrancy assumption). (3) MAIN-DAX EXEMPT, VDAO-DAX NOT -- feeExempt={factory,address(this),varo,veo,vdax(mainDax)}; the VDAO-DAX is deliberately non-exempt (balance-delta accounting). Token fully immutable (no admin/owner/upgrade/setter). Supply: constructor mints EXACTLY 2x activeSupply (no other mint path), burns only shrink. Vesting: linear, capped at vestTotal, CEI-correct, creator-only, no over-claim, no reentrancy. Closed-circuit: only V-DAO exits = active half->VARO (launch caller), vest->immutable creator, fee->burn; no arbitrary recipient, no rescue/sweep; neither contract holds VY/USDC/asset.
audit.findings: C1 factory _authorizeUpgrade (DEFAULT_ADMIN, no timelock) controls how ALL FUTURE V-DAOs are minted (redirect active half / mint to attacker / rotate VARO / bake exemptions); deployed tokens immutable & unaffected; kept Critical for blast-radius consistency (workflow rated High). H1 setVeo/setMainDax weaponize the PERMANENT exempt wiring baked into future tokens (attacker router/DEX -> fee skim / reserve poisoning; irreversible per cohort; bumped to High per workflow). M1 creator vest = 50% of max supply over 1yr + ~10% launch cut (tokenomics; creator's own token + launcher's own seeded liquidity, NOT protocol VY/backing; transparent on-chain; buyer disclosure). Lows: L1 fee rounds to 0 for value<143 (dust); L2 layer previewNames external-calls parent.symbol() (operational; atomic-revert, NO permanent name-locking -- the 'permanent locking' over-claim was REFUTED, previewNames runs before the reserve); L3 setVaro rotation sequencing (varo starts 0; rotate carefully); L4 storage gap sizing on upgrades. Info: CREATE2 cannot be griefed (launch is VARO_ROLE-only, the only CREATE2 path).
